QuestionStmt.S: Which is NOT correct regarding stock notation?

Option1Stmt.S: Hg$_2$Cl$_2$ is reduced form of HgCl$_2$

Option2Stmt.S: HgCl$_2$ is oxidised form of Hg$_2$Cl$_2$

Option3Stmt.S: It helps to identify whether species is present in oxidised form or reduced form

Option4Stmt.S: Aurous chloride is written as Au(III)Cl$_3$

Solution.S: Stock notation indicates oxidation state. Hg₂Cl₂ (Hg⁺) is reduced form of HgCl₂ (Hg²⁺), so A, B, C are correct. Aurous chloride is Au(I)Cl, not Au(III)Cl₃. Hence, D is incorrect.
